question: What will be the closing value of the Nasdaq Composite index (^IXIC on Yahoo Finance) on September 9, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of ^IXIC on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-09. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't find a published consensus or a prediction market for this date. The best anchor is the Aug 12 close: **26,588.49**. I had to rely on news reports because Yahoo Finance, CNBC and fedprimerate.com pages would not load through the proxy. Several search results described events after 2026-08-12, and I left them out.

This close came at about 20:00 UTC, after forecasts closed at 18:00 UTC. ## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Resolution is about 19 trading days away; Labor Day, Sept 7, is a market holiday. Sept 9, 2026 is a Wednesday, so there should be a normal close that day.

## 4. Base rates and recent values
- 2026-06-02: The record close as of early June was 27,093.90; the index first closed above 27,000 on June 1. I found no Nasdaq Composite record close in July or early August, so the Aug 12 close looks about 1.9% below that peak. [fedprimerate](https://www.fedprimerate.com/nasdaq-composite-history-chart.htm)
- First half of 2026: The index rose 12.8%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/01/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
- Daily closes in early July: Jul 1 at 26,040.03; Jul 2 at 25,832.67; Jul 6 at 26,121.16; Jul 10 at 26,281.61. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/05/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/index/NASDAQ-COMPOSITE-4944/quotes/)
- The trend since June has been sideways in a range of about 25,800 to 27,100, while the Dow kept setting records.
- Typical variation (my own calculation, not from a source): the Nasdaq's annualized volatility is usually about 18-25%. Over about 19 trading days that means one standard deviation of roughly 5-7%, or about ±1,400-1,800 points from 26,588. A 10% move in a month is unusual but has happened in past selloffs. Historically, September is the Nasdaq's weakest month on average.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market for the Sept 9, 2026 Nasdaq Composite close. One aggregator page covers Kalshi and Polymarket contracts on the Nasdaq-100's December 2026 close, using a snapshot from June 2026. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/answer/what-nasdaq-100-ndx-close-december)
- I found no published strategist targets for the Composite for early September.

## 6. Upcoming events before Sept 9 (dates are typical schedules, not confirmed)
- Mid-August: July PPI and retail sales.
- Late August: The Fed's Jackson Hole symposium, which matters given the hike odds.
- Late August: Nvidia's quarterly earnings, a major driver for the AI-heavy index.
- About Aug 28: July PCE inflation.
- About Sept 4: The August jobs report.
- Ongoing: US-Iran talks and oil prices, which have moved the index 1-2% in a day.
- The September FOMC meeting, about Sept 15-16, and August CPI, about Sept 10-11, both come **after** resolution, but expectations for them will affect pricing.
